mapper.select: SELECT d.*, pd.name as parent_name, dg.name as grade_name, e.name as director_name, IFNULL(emp_stats.employee_count, 0) as employee_count, IFNULL(pos_stats.position_count, 0) as position_count FROM department d LEFT JOIN department pd ON d.parent_id = pd.id AND pd.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN department_grade dg ON d.gradeid = dg.id AND dg.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN employee e ON d.director_id = e.id AND e.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) as employee_count FROM employee WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 2) GROUP BY department_id ) emp_stats ON d.id = emp_stats.department_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) as position_count FROM work_position WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY department_id ) pos_stats ON d.id = pos_stats.department_id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM department WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY gradeid, created_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE department SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT d.id FROM department d INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON d.parent_id = dt.id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted = 0 ) SELECT id FROM dept_tree

SELECT -- 基础统计 IFNULL(direct_emp.employee_count, 0) as employee_count, IFNULL(pos_count.position_count, 0) as position_count, IFNULL(child_dept.child_department_count, 0) as child_department_count,
-- 包含子部门的员工统计 IFNULL(all_emp.total_employee_count, 0) as total_employee_count, IFNULL(status_stats.on_job_employee_count, 0) as on_job_employee_count, IFNULL(status_stats.probation_employee_count, 0) as probation_employee_count, IFNULL(status_stats.leave_employee_count, 0) as leave_employee_count, IFNULL(manager_stats.manager_count, 0) as manager_count,
-- 年龄和性别统计 IFNULL(age_gender.average_age, 0) as average_age, IFNULL(age_gender.male_ratio, 0) as male_ratio, IFNULL(age_gender.female_ratio, 0) as female_ratio FROM department d
-- 直属员工数量 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) as employee_count FROM employee WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY department_id ) direct_emp ON d.id = direct_emp.department_id
-- 岗位数量 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) as position_count FROM work_position WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY department_id ) pos_count ON d.id = pos_count.department_id
-- 子部门数量 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT parent_id, COUNT(*) as child_department_count FROM department WHERE parent_id = #{departmentId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY parent_id ) child_dept ON d.id = child_dept.parent_id
-- 总员工数量（包含子部门） LEFT JOIN ( WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT dept.id FROM department dept INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON dept.parent_id = dt.id WHERE dept.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept.deleted = 0 ) SELECT COUNT(*) as total_employee_count FROM employee e INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON e.department_id = dt.id WHERE e.deleted = 0 ) all_emp ON 1=1
-- 员工状态统计 LEFT JOIN ( WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT dept.id FROM department dept INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON dept.parent_id = dt.id WHERE dept.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept.deleted = 0 ) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as on_job_employee_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as probation_employee_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as leave_employee_count FROM employee e INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON e.department_id = dt.id WHERE e.deleted = 0 ) status_stats ON 1=1
-- 管理人员统计 LEFT JOIN ( WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT dept.id FROM department dept INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON dept.parent_id = dt.id WHERE dept.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept.deleted = 0 ) SELECT COUNT(*) as manager_count FROM employee e INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON e.department_id = dt.id INNER JOIN work_position wp ON e.position_id = wp.id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.status IN (1, 2) AND wp.is_manager = 1 AND wp.deleted = 0 ) manager_stats ON 1=1
-- 年龄和性别统计 LEFT JOIN ( WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT dept.id FROM department dept INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON dept.parent_id = dt.id WHERE dept.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept.deleted = 0 ) SELECT AVG(YEAR(NOW()) - YEAR(e.birth_date)) as average_age, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN e.gender = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as male_ratio, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN e.gender = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as female_ratio FROM employee e INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON e.department_id = dt.id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.status IN (1, 2) ) age_gender ON 1=1
WHERE d.id = #{departmentId} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted = 0

WITH RECURSIVE dept_path AS ( SELECT id, name, parent_id, 1 as level FROM department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT d.id, d.name, d.parent_id, dp.level + 1 FROM department d INNER JOIN dept_path dp ON d.id = dp.parent_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted = 0 ) SELECT id, name, parent_id FROM dept_path ORDER BY level DESC

SELECT DISTINCT d.* FROM department d INNER JOIN user_department_role udr ON d.id = udr.department_id WHERE udr.user_id = #{userId} AND udr.role_type IN ('MANAGER', 'ADMIN') AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.gradeid, d.created_at

SELECT CASE WHEN #{parentId} = 0 THEN 1 -- 根部门 WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM department WHERE id = #{parentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND gradeid = #{gradeId} - 1 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as valid
